periods.time: vol-11 ch-003 award ceremony after the final

name.zh: 第六十二届七星剑武祭颁奖典礼

periods.summary: At the award ceremony, Amane's disqualification gives Ouma third place by default, though he has already left Osaka. Stella receives runner-up honors, and Ikki receives the championship certificate and the title Seven Stars Sword King. Kurono hands him Hagun's school flag, which Toka had entrusted to him, and Ikki raises it from the top of the podium as spectators and former rivals congratulate him.
periods.cause: Ikki wins the final and fulfills Hagun's goal of claiming the Seven Stars crown.
periods.outcome: Ikki's once-denied path is publicly validated; he resolves to grow even stronger so he can live up to the title and everyone's blessings.
periods.significance: Completes Ikki's long-term goal of becoming Seven Stars Sword King and fulfills his promise as Hagun's representative captain.
